OWNED FILES: storygame/runtime/engine.py (edit); tests/test_refusal_modes.py (edit). Edit nothing else.

CONTEXT: RuntimeEngine has refusal modes 'off', 'clause', 'repair', 'renarrate' (see `_handle_refusal`, `_refusal_rewrite`, `_splice_refusal_segments`, `_call_refusal_provider`). Two defects to fix:

DEFECT 1: `_splice_refusal_segments` replaces EVERY narration/dialogue segment of the proposal with the model's replacement. But the proposal's segments include authored text appended by the engine (cue/reveal delivery text, the verbatim complication segment, the verbatim authored handoff) that the provider did not write. Those must survive. FIX: replace ONLY the segments that the provider itself authored. Pass the original `provider_proposal` (the parsed provider reply, available in `turn()` as `provider_proposal`; on the pending-resume path use the pending proposal's own segments only if no better source exists, and say so in notes) into `_handle_refusal` / `_refusal_rewrite`, and treat a proposal segment as provider-authored when its (kind, text) equals one of provider_proposal.segments. Splice: put the replacement segments where the FIRST provider-authored segment was, drop the other provider-authored ones, keep every other segment in its original order. If no segment is provider-authored, append the replacement before the first non-provider segment... no: simply fall back to the clause for that turn with the issue 'refusal re-narration failed: no provider segments'. The 'repair' prompt's ORIGINAL REPLY text must likewise include only the provider-authored segments' text.

DEFECT 2: the extra provider call (`_call_refusal_provider`) goes through CloudflareTurnProvider.request code that stores the second reply's item_facts in the provider (`_pending_item_facts`, `_pending_item_facts_present`) and overwrites `last_prompt`. Capture has already run for this turn, so after the extra call: call `self.provider.discard_pending_item_facts()` when the provider has it, and restore the provider's `last_prompt` to its value from before the extra call (use getattr/setattr guards so stub providers without them still work). The extra call must never change world facts.

TESTS (edit tests/test_refusal_modes.py): add (a) a case where the proposal has a provider segment plus an engine-appended authored segment (build it the way the existing tests do, for instance a must-convey/cue delivery or by appending a segment through a stub reveal resolver or a complication-verbatim fact; if that is hard, unit-test `_splice_refusal_segments` directly with a hand-built proposal and a provider_proposal) and assert the authored segment survives in both 'renarrate' and 'repair'; (b) a case asserting that after an extra call the provider's pending item facts are discarded and last_prompt is restored (with a stub provider exposing those attributes). Keep every existing assertion; if an existing test needs a signature change, update it minimally.

HOW TO RUN: confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_refusal_modes.py tests/test_refused_move_clause.py tests/test_unknown_identity_not_creation.py tests/test_bench_item_facts.py. Also `-k "bench or engine or capture or item_facts"` over tests/. Ruff: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix and -m ruff format on both files. Reply with the files changed.
